verdicts.reason: A: the orange divider has slipped down and now underlines 'Ships late June', so it collides with that text. The body copy is jammed straight under the headline with no breathing room, the CTA stretches almost edge to edge, and the bottom third is dead navy space. B: the white logo band stops short of the right edge, leaving a navy notch that looks broken. The divider is half-hidden behind the top of the CTA button, the body copy is small and crammed under the headline, and the bottom is also empty. B's broken band is the more visible brand defect, so A wins narrowly.
